cohort: The study included 161 women with Type 1 Diabetes and 161 age and gravidity matched healthy control women admitted to Mayo Clinic, Rochester, MN for delivery between January 2006 and December 2020.
finding: Pregnancies with Type 1 Diabetes continue to be associated with suboptimal glycemic control and higher maternal and perinatal morbidity compared to pregnancies in women without Type 1 Diabetes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more common in women with Type 1 Diabetes.
gest_age: Preterm delivery, gestational age for classification of large for gestational age
